docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Sadānanda’s Vedāntasāra, the short summary of Advaita Vedānta, with its Sanskrit text, an English translation and Jacob’s notes (London, 1888). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Robarts Library, University of Toronto; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: A manual of Hindu pantheism, the Vedantasara · Jacob, George Adolphus · 1888, 174 scanned pages. Published 1888; George Adolphus Jacob died 1918; Sadānanda is medieval; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text.
